claims.claim_text: PACS operates over 200 (208) post-acute care facilities across nine states (AZ, CA, CO, KY, MO, NV, OH, SC, TX), one of the largest SNF operators in the US by facility count per CMS data.
claims.subject: PACS Group, Inc.
claims.source_quote: with over 200 post-acute care facilities across nine states serving over 20,000 patients daily ... As of December 31, 2023, we had 32,433 employees working across 208 post-acute care facilities in 9 states

claims.claim_text: As of Dec 31 2023, PACS's average CMS Quality Measures (QM) Star rating across all facilities was 4.1 Stars, versus the industry average of 3.6 Stars.
claims.subject: PACS Group, Inc.
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2023, our average QM Star rating across all our facilities was 4.1 Stars, compared to the industry average of 3.6 Stars.

claims.claim_text: For the years 2023/2022/2021, PACS's average occupancy rate across Mature facilities was 93%/92%/88% vs industry averages of 76%/74%/71%.
claims.subject: PACS Group, Inc.
claims.source_quote: our average occupancy rate across our Mature facilities ... was 93%, 92%, and 88%, respectively, compared to the industry average of 76%, 74% and 71%.

claims.claim_text: Medicare and Medicaid are PACS's largest sources of revenue, accounting for 38.6% and 37.6% of routine revenue (year ended Dec 31 2023); Medicare program was 39%/48%/44% of net patient & resident revenue for 2023/2022/2021.
claims.subject: PACS Group, Inc.
claims.source_quote: Medicare and Medicaid, which represent our largest sources of revenue and accounted for 38.6% and 37.6% of our routine revenue for the year ended December 31, 2023 ... the Medicare program amounted to 39%, 48%, and 44% of the Company's combined/consolidated net patient and resident revenue

claims.claim_text: PACS generated total revenue of $3.1 billion for the year ended Dec 31 2023 (vs $2.4 billion in 2022), with total net income of $112.9 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $237.5 million; audited by Ernst & Young LLP.
claims.subject: PACS Group, Inc.
claims.object_value: $3.1B revenue / $112.9M net income FY2023, EY auditor
claims.source_quote: For the year ended December 31, 2023, we generated total revenue of $3.1 billion ... total net income of $112.9 million ... Adjusted EBITDA of $237.5 million ... Ernst & Young LLP, independent registered public accounting firm, has audited our combined/consolidated financial statements

claims.claim_text: PACS has grown by acquisition, adding operations at 58 facilities (6,744 beds) in 2023, 9 facilities (1,180 beds) in 2022, and the Plum Healthcare Group acquisition (58 facilities, 6,380 SNF beds) in Nov 2021 for $121M; over 195 facilities acquired/integrated to date.
claims.subject: PACS Group, Inc.
claims.source_quote: having successfully acquired and integrated over 195 facilities to date ... On November 5, 2021, the Company completed the acquisition of all of the equity interest of 58 stand-alone skilled nursing, assisted living, and subacute facilities ... from ... Plum Healthcare Group (Plum) for $121,000

claims.claim_text: PACS reports a voluntary facility-administrator turnover rate of 3.1% (year ended Dec 31 2023) and RVP average industry experience of 12.1 years, supporting low-turnover workforce-quality claims.
claims.subject: PACS Group, Inc.
claims.source_quote: RVPs who had average industry experience of 12.1 years, as of December 31, 2023. For the year ended December 31, 2023, we had a voluntary turnover rate of 3.1% among our facility administrators.
